title: IntakeRecord
description: What Intake decided about one WorkItem: the thread it belongs to and the route it takes. Written by the orchestrator to intake/intake.json and validated before the state machine acts on the route. Internal to Factorial, not part of the WorkItem API.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

route.description: Which path through the fixed stage graph the item takes: change (Prepare, Build, Collect, Test, Review, OpenPullRequest), or refuse (nothing runs; the refusal is recorded and, when a person asked, answered).

turn.description: What kind of turn the item is: a new request, a resumed attempt at an earlier request, or a turn on a pull request Factorial opened.

reason.description: Why this route, in a sentence.

threadKey.description: The thread the item belongs to, `<owner>/<name>#<branch>`. Absent when the item was refused before its thread was found.

pullRequest.description: For a turn on a pull request, its number.

cause.description: For a turn on a pull request, why it needs rework, derived from what happened.

previousWorkItemId.description: For a turn on a pull request, the item that opened it, from the thread.

resumedFrom.description: For a resumed attempt, the attempt it continues.

refusal.description: For the refuse route: the ledger status recorded and whether the refusal is answered on the pull request. Since #165 the GitHub reporter posts the answer from the refused outcome; `replied` says one is due.
